Before being allowed to race again, VIEW OF COSMOS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped shortly after the start.  M F Poon pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 150 Metres (see DOUBLE WIN).  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded between VOLCANIC SPARK and FORTUNE KINGO which shifted out.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by GREY CHARGER which jumped awkwardly and shifted in.

Prior to declaring weighed-in Trainer K L Man and Jockey C Y Ho viewed the Stewards’ patrol films to ascertain if there were grounds for a protest/objection against VOLCANIC SPARK (M F Poon) being declared the second placegetter.  When connections declined to lodge a protest/objection and the Stewards were satisfied there were not sufficient grounds having regard to the 1 ½ length margin between the two horses at the finish of the race, weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  At a subsequent inquiry M F Poon pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 150 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out whilst riding it along when insufficiently clear of DOUBLE WIN, resulting in DOUBLE WIN being taken from its rightful running and having to be restrained to avoid the heels of VOLCANIC SPARK.  M F Poon was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 12 April 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.

Jumped only fairly. Near the 1500 Metres was contacted by STORM RUNNER when STORM RUNNER (A Atzeni) shifted to the outside of GREY CHARGER.  As a result SUPREME MASTERMIND was hampered and taken wider.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care.  L Ferraris reported that after this incident his mount did not travel well during the race and gave ground in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPREME MASTERMIND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 250 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with SERANGOON due to both runners shifting ground.  When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages and the reason he made a forward move from the 1500 Metres when the early stages of the event were being run inside of standard time A Atzeni stated that he was given the instructions to go forward and as the race appeared to lack pace he was also given the option of leading if circumstances permitted.  He said after being crossed by FORTUNE KINGO and GREY CHARGER in the early stages he held a position behind those two runners.  He said near the 1500 Metres he felt the pace eased, particularly when R Kingscote, rider of GREY CHARGER, restrained his mount.  He said as a consequence this resulted in STORM RUNNER racing keenly at which point he elected to shift out near the 1500 Metres to go forward.  He added that as he then continued forward to cross FORTUNE KINGO and GREY CHARGER those two runners held their position which resulted in him having to make more use of his mount along the Back Straight where he was able to cross GREY CHARGER near the 1200 Metres.  He said due to the manner in which he was obliged to ride his mount in the middle stages to cross GREY CHARGER, STORM RUNNER was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued.  He stated that whilst his preference would have been for STORM RUNNER to maintain its position with cover near the 1500 Metres he accepted Jockey Atzeni’s explanation as to why he elected to shift out and start a forward move.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Atzeni that, having regard to the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time, he made an error of judgement by not making more effort to remain racing behind GREY CHARGER to avoid having to make too much use of his mount to cross the early leaders.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of STORM RUNNER was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, STORM RUNNER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
